This template is to be used for [[Wookieepedia:Sourcing|citing]] exhibitions displays from museum, conventions, etc., and requires the support of an image file, which in turn must be added to one of the pages under [[Wookieepedia:Database]], such as [[Wookieepedia:Database/Exhibits]] or a page dedicated to a specific convention.

==Usage==
Copy the template code below, and paste it into an article's reference note.

<code><nowiki>{{VisualMediaCite|title=|location=|file=}}</nowiki></code>

===Required parameters===
*{{Para|title}} Title of the display being cited.
*{{Para|location}} Name of the location where the display was exposed. Provide wikilinks as needed.
*{{Para|file}} Full filename of the image of the display.

===Examples===
<code><nowiki>{{ExhibitCite|title=T-70 X-Wing Starfighter - Screen-Used Vehicle|location=[[Wikipedia:National Air and Space Museum|National Air and Space Museum]]|file=File:T-70XWing-Exhibition1.jpg}}</nowiki></code>

'''Results in''':<br />
{{ExhibitCite|title=T-70 X-Wing Starfighter - Screen-Used Vehicle|location=[[Wikipedia:National Air and Space Museum|National Air and Space Museum]]|file=File:T-70XWing-Exhibition1.jpg}}
